body.statement: If every \(T_e\) has rank two, \(\mathcal C_A(T)\) is exactly the union of at most \(2^4\) products of closed rational endpoint intervals obtained by orienting each observed segment. On each nonempty product, \(\tau_C\) is constant if and only if the endpoint intervals for response types \(1,2,4\) are singletons. Global rigidity holds if and only if those constants agree across all products; otherwise rational endpoint choices yield a legal target-changing certificate.
body.justification: This is the complete boundary result on the largest regular-rank branch and exhibits target rigidity without factor uniqueness.
body.gap: Rank-two segment geometry is standard, but no prior result glues four labeled cells and characterizes only PN/PS constancy across orientation components.
body.consumer: It certifies assignment-boundary PN/PS values on singular support faces.
